result.reason: The addition is targeted and preserves the unrelated operational provisions, and it adequately addresses pre-existing HDI IP, embedded-IP licensing, and no joint ownership. However, the operative assignment covers only “deliverables created specifically” for the Company, not all related work product created for it. The definition of Company Data is also limited to specified data collected through the Site and does not clearly cover all data supplied or made available by the Company. The margin comment therefore overstates the scope of the operative language.
